verdict.rationale: ReadMe evidences several bulk-style operations: Docs Audit runs linter rules across every page in one pass, Reusable Content blocks update all instances of a snippet at once, and the official rdme CLI enables scripted, headless operations that could drive bulk create/update workflows across many docs. However there's no direct evidence of a bulk API (e.g., batch create/update/delete of multiple items in a single call) explicitly designed for AI-native mass operations. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints, explicit examples of AI agents performing multi-item bulk edits via MCP or API, and independent confirmation of bulk-operation reliability at scale.
